description: This Java class 'DataUtils' provides utility functions for processing and converting measurement data related to a MerchantStore, including postal code sanitization, weight conversion between units (LB and KG), and measurement unit conversions (IN and CM).

classes.name: DataUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for data normalization and measurement conversions related to merchant stores.

methods.name: trimPostalCode
methods.description: Removes all non-alphanumeric characters from the postal code string.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Converts weight between pounds and kilograms based on store settings and desired measurement unit.

methods.name: getMeasure
methods.description: Converts measurement between inches and centimeters based on store settings and desired measurement unit.
